title: Auto-pseudonymisation does not work properly if output is not CSV
body: Case in point: the Twitter data source which output NDJSON - the output doesn't bypasses the pseudonymisation in that case
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: This pull request [#146 ](https://github.com/digitalmethodsinitiative/4cat/pull/146) adds a recursive function that will search a dictionary for any keys matching a specific string and apply a function to the corresponding value. As applied to ndjson in this pull request, it searches each item and uses the same hash function for pseudonymization that the csv uses on author information.

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
